lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: A robed figure with a staff. The moss has most of the face and all of the hands.

lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: Someone made this to be looked at, and then everyone got used to it. That's how most monuments die.

lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: There's a plate under the green. Good morning, then. Gently.

lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: A robed figure. A staff. Ears, from a sculptor who'd only been told about them.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: FREYJA. WHO MADE IT RAIN ON ONE TOMATO, AND THEN ON ALL OF US. THE ROAD REMEMBERS.

lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: ...One tomato. A woman who'd been kind about my boots.

lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: I made it rain on a plant for an afternoon. I never looked behind me to see how far it went.

lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: Pippa will want to know who it is.
